text:
olivia_csm: Heads-up: Meridian Tech dedicated pool bring-up tomorrow 11:00 PT. Need final quota + autoscale knobs + customer enablement. Quick sync? :wave:

trent_infra: I propose reserving 6x A40 to start, limit 10 via autoscale. Customer asked for conservative start.

julia_account: Meridian agreed to 6 initially, wants a plan to go to 10 if latency spikes. They asked for a cost estimate for week1.

hana_sre: Autoscale suggestion:
- scale out +1 at GPU util > 68% for 180s
- scale in -1 when util < 33% for 600s
- max scale ops per 10m = 2

vikram_ml: Load mix: 30% embeddings (short), 50% chat (1k tokens), 20% rerank. Seed bucket: s3://meridian/onboard/seeds-2026.txt

olivia_csm: @vikram_ml drop loadgen flags pls. Also we need a short enablement call for their infra team at 10:15 PT.

vikram_ml: loadgen cmd:
```
loadgen --target https://dedicated.redwood/meridian --qps 150 --duration 3600 \
  --profile mixed --seeds s3://meridian/onboard/seeds-2026.txt --concurrency 40
```

trent_infra: I'll run prewarm 25m before start to populate KV cache and compile kernels. prewarm.sh:
```
./tools/prewarm.sh --pool meridian --minutes 25
```

ci-bot: Event created: 1751237400  meridian-dedicated-provision

hana_sre: Add canary: 1 instance handles 4% traffic for 7m, then 15m ramp to 30%, then full. Fallback: reroute to hosted family if p95 > 2.8s for 180s.

julia_account: Sending invite to meridian-eng@ and ops contact. I'll also include the week1 cost delta estimate once infra posts numbers.

trent_infra: Will tag logs with customer:meridian and env:dedicated. Posting perf dashboards to #ops-dashboard during run.

vikram_ml: If we observe CPU-bound worker saturation, reduce qps by 20% and re-assess. Also watch cache hit rate > 65%.

olivia_csm: Great. Quick go/no-go at 10:40 PT. We'll capture feedback in the post-run form: https://forms.redwood/bringup-feedback. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
